brand_positioning: SHREE ENTERPRISE — BUILDING WITH TRUST — Since 2010

typography.overline: text-xs md:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-[#FF4A1C]
rules: No Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.
Use typography to create structural boundaries—treat text as building blocks.
typography.installation: Import Cabinet Grotesk from fontshare or standard CSS imports, and Manrope from Google Fonts.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24, py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
layouts.grid_strategy: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID (Asymmetrical, high visual tension). Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly. Leave breathing room.
layouts.container_alignment: Optically aligned. Center alignment ONLY for specific dramatic editorial moments. Default to strong left-alignment to reflect architectural blueprints.
layouts.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10) to create architectural grid structures across the page.

buttons.style: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary: bg-[#FF4A1C] text-white hover:bg-[#E03A10] transition-colors. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
buttons.animation: Include a subtle group-hover arrow translation.

cards.style: Cardless or flat solid surface (bg-[#171717]). NO soft shadows. 1px solid border. Inner padding p-8 or p-12.
cards.images: Spotlighted or clipped frames. Never generic rounded rects. Use aspect ratios like 3:4 or 16:9 deliberately.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a 1px solid bottom border (border-white/10). Sticky top.
navigation.links: Hover state must be explicitly styled (e.g., text-[#FF4A1C]).

footer.style: Massive structural layout. Deep dark (or stark light contrast). py-32. Huge typographic logo at the bottom (text-[10vw]).

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle concrete/paper noise overlay on the entire site to remove digital flatness (pointer-events-none, fixed, opacity-20).
visual_enhancers.lines: Architectural grid lines dividing sections horizontally and vertically.
visual_enhancers.numbers: Large, outline, architectural numbers (e.g., text-8xl text-transparent stroke-white) for numbered manifesto chapters.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial drift. Font: Cabinet Grotesk, uppercase, outlined text, tracking-widest.

motion.hero_animation: Masked line-by-line reveal for 'BUILDING WITH TRUST'. Staggered entrance for hero elements.
motion.scroll_reveals: Fade up with slight y-axis translation (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on large signature project images using framer-motion useScroll.

hero.description: High contrast building under construction with a crane. Use with a bg-black/40 overlay.

signature_projects.description: Gray metal building frame near tower crane
Gray concrete bridge on body of water (Civil Infrastructure)

equipment_and_machinery.description: Yellow and black excavator on rocky ground
Heavy loader equipment on brown field

universal_guidelines: NEVER center align the entire app container.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers/navbars; always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent dark bg.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use stark contrasts, deliberate borders, and sharp UI elements.
Incorporate 2-3x more spacing than feels normal. Let the content breathe.
Every interactive element MUST have explicitly defined hover states. Text visibility MUST be guaranteed on hover.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs).
Replace standard rounded edges with sharp or near-sharp edges to match the 'construction/architectural' vibe.
DO NOT use generic gradients. Keep colors flat, dense, and purposeful. Add noise/textures instead of gloss.
Images should have purposeful aspect ratios (e.g., tall 3:4 for people, wide 16:9 for projects) and utilize object-cover.
If using a Map, style it dark to match the theme. No default bright Google Maps styling.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required font: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local assets) and configure it in tailwind.config.js.
Install framer-motion and @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling and animations.
Build the hero section with a dark overlay (bg-black/50) over the background image, and implement a staggering line-by-line reveal for the headline 'BUILDING WITH TRUST'.
Create an 'Editorial Marquee' section using framer-motion to continuously scroll text slowly.
Use a CSS noise texture overlay globally on the App wrapper with pointer-events: none.
Ensure all data cards (equipment, projects, people) lack generic drop shadows. Rely on 1px borders (border-white/10) to define bounds.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms. Example: data-testid='contact-submit-button'.
Make the website fully responsive, defaulting to single columns on mobile, scaling up to complex bento/asymmetrical grids on md/lg viewports.
